omm_stream.Definition

This class to subscribe to streaming items of any Domain Model (e.g. MarkePrice, MarketByPrice, ...) exposed by the underlying of the LSEG Data

Available as lseg.data.delivery.omm_stream.Definition.

Syntax

Definition(
    name: str,
    api: str | None = None,
    service: str | None = None,
    fields: OptStrStrs = None,
    domain: str = 'MarketPrice',
    extended_params: ExtendedParams = None,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
name str Yes Streaming instrument name.
api str | None No None Streaming data source.
service str | None No None Third-party service URL to manage the streaming data.
fields OptStrStrs No None Single field or list of fields to return.
domain str No 'MarketPrice' Specific streaming data domain.
extended_params ExtendedParams No None Specifies the parameters that will be merged with the request.

Methods

get_stream

Returns the previously defined data stream from the Data Platform.

get_stream(session: Session = None) -> OMMStream

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.

Returns

OMMStream instance

Example

from lseg.data.delivery import omm_stream
definition = omm_stream.Definition("EUR")
stream = definition.get_stream()
